svg.title: Vale and Ananya agree to preserve the exchange while correcting its hazards.
svg.desc: A scorched socket and restricted-access book sit between Vale and Ananya. Vale says functioning equipment can still be unsafe; Ananya agrees to repair rather than erase the essential system.
svg.text: Page 18, panel 4 · Eye-level opposed shot across unlabeled repairs and a scorched socket

text.tspan: Vale orders the exchange documented and retained,
with its fire and access risks corrected.

svg.text: CONTEXTUAL PRODUCTION PLACEHOLDER — ART NOT PUBLIC
